description: Emperor Time TDD iron law. Use BEFORE writing or editing production code for a feature, bugfix, refactor, or behavior change. No production code without a failing probe first. Delete implementation written before the probe failed. Prediction is ledgered before the command. Also use when writing or changing tests (name the break, exercise the real thing, no mirror assertions). Complements scientific-method.md.
